toulonmarinemuseum.name: Musée national de la Marine
toulonmarinemuseum.slogan: Ship models and figureheads behind the arsenal's 1738 gate.
toulonmarinemuseum.line: The museum's entrance is the arsenal's old monumental gate, dated 1738, and it has stood beside the Tour de l'Horloge since 1981.

thoronetabbey.name: Abbaye du Thoronet
thoronetabbey.slogan: Bare Cistercian stone, shaped entirely by Provençal light.
thoronetabbey.line: The light and the shadow are the loudspeakers of this architecture of truth.
thoronetabbey.by: Le Corbusier, after visiting Le Thoronet

porquerollesbike.name: Porquerolles
porquerollesbike.slogan: Pedal a car-free island of pines, vines and white-sand coves.
porquerollesbike.line: François Fournier bought the whole 1,254-hectare island in 1912, apparently as a wedding present for his wife.

sainttropezannonciade.name: Musée de l'Annonciade
sainttropezannonciade.slogan: Signac's Saint-Tropez, hung inside a 16th-century chapel.
sainttropezannonciade.line: Paul Signac discovered Saint-Tropez in 1892; in 1955 its chapel opened as a museum with 56 works from Georges Grammont's collection.

toulonfarontelepherique.name: Mont Faron
toulonfarontelepherique.slogan: Lift off from the harbour and see the whole roadstead at once.
toulonfarontelepherique.line: From 1952 to 1970 the road up Mont Faron, 584 m high, hosted a cycling time trial; Bahamontes won it four times.
